description:
Kelly Estates are privileged to offer a distinguished, detached dormer bungalow superbly positioned on the Main Street in Newcastle. This exceptional home combines character with contemporary living having been upgraded and extended. Set on a superb c.0.30 acre south-facing site, the property enjoys an enviable sense of space and natural light, suitable for right sizers and families alike, it is an outstanding home in one of South County Dublin’s most sought-after locations.

"Bellamar" is a beautiful 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom detached bungalow that’s presented in immaculate condition having been meticulously maintained by the current owner, this property offers an abundance of accommodation throughout. The c. 0.30 site offers huge potential to the righthand side of the property to develop further and with space to extend the property to the rear. The property benefits from gas fired central heating, gated side access and a solid built workshop.

Newcastle is a well-established residential area, perfectly positioned close to an array of amenities. Built in c.1964 and extended in the early 1970's the property has been maintained to a high standard and is in excellent decorative order throughout.

The mature front garden is primarily in lawn scattered with small trees and the boundaries are solid stone built walls. The rear garden is very secure and a real sun trap that is perfect for entertaining.

This extremely convenient location is a stone throw away from all local amenities, you could not ask for a more central position! This wonderful home with Dublin bus providing an easy commute to Dublin City Centre, is within easy access to the N7 and M50 Motorway & surrounding areas, Shopping Centre's such as Citywest Shopping Centre & Liffey Valley Shopping Centre are all close by, this wonderful property hosts an abundance of amenities just at your doorstep!

Please note: Visit Kelly Estates on Facebook, Instagram or Tiktok for videos of the property. Early interest is expected, be sure to contact Kelly Estates today for further information or to arrange viewing! All measurements are approximate and photographs provided for guidance only.
